scope: Static source/schema review only; no source edits; not execution or physical validation
positive_findings: Shared real/synthetic candidate parent wall is deduplicated by physical execution_batch_id, not multiplied by worker count.
Latest cost source requires D1/L explicit ledgers and separates exact measured subtotal from conservative upper-bound subtotal.
Unknown CPU/actual CUDA activity/full simultaneous RSS remain null; missing SAM CUDA events are not extrapolated to exact activity.
B raw v1 failure and v2 representation reconciliation remain separate geometry evidence; six axes are not collapsed to one overall PASS.
Finite and D1 scientific source closures plus approved memoization amendment source/evidence hashes are checked before GO.
The evaluator validates complete plan-bound prediction bytes, exact238 identities/arms and canonical protocol before decoding fixed reference poses.
No new model inference, training, optimization or GT pose decoding is imported by the new cost wrapper/assembler.

findings.problem: Initial root cost assembly silently omitted all D1 jobs because the producer exposed unique_execution_batches but no distinct_batch_wall_ledger.
findings.latest: Latest producer now emits the ledger; root requires it and preserves wall_is_upper_bound with exact/upper subtotals. No actual final receipt or cost result was examined.
findings.fix: Keep explicit missing-ledger failure and shared parent execution ID once.

findings.problem: The concrete profiler schema uses total_host_seconds. The currently used aliases do not exist, so an actually measured technical GPU profile is reported as null.
findings.fix: Read total_host_seconds, with explicit documented aliases only; keep null for genuinely absent measurements.

findings.problem: The GPU limit check charges bulk real/synthetic observation host wall only. Separate technical CAL/synthetic observation passes and the cold/warm technical profile also execute GPU forwards but are omitted from that cap check.
findings.evidence: D1_COST unique_execution_batches explicitly contains GPU_OBSERVATION and TECHNICAL_GPU_OBSERVATION physical execution jobs.
findings.fix: Report bulk separately and compute a conservative all-known-GPU-job host-wall upper subtotal once per physical execution_batch_id, including technical jobs. Do not claim exact GPU activity or substitute CUDA capture gaps with zero.

findings.problem: A publication status can override a missing/failed visual review or failed privacy/rights review; with no publication success a visual PASS can likewise look like the combined axis PASS while publication is pending.
findings.fix: Preserve visual/publication/privacy/rights as distinct substatuses. Combined status must explicitly remain pending/fail unless the required conditions are met; an offline PUBLICATION_CHECK is separate from actual remote verification.

findings.problem: model_review=True is unconditional even when no VISUAL_REVIEW receipt exists. This can imply pixel review before actual viewing.
findings.fix: Derive pixel-review completion and reviewer type from an actual visual receipt; otherwise mark absent/pending. Static model code review may be a separately named evidence type.

findings.problem: progress omits L entirely when the training manifest is absent; validation then tests only existing branches. Six completed non-L seals could produce EXECUTION_COMPLETENESS PASS without any L branch. INPUT_AND_VERSION also checks only truthiness of a gate dict, not all_registered_predictions_sealed or its current digests.
findings.fix: Require the exact seven branch keys including L, expected row/run inventories, and the valid bound scoring gate. Keep actual gate/assembler checks as evidence, not mere existence.

findings.problem: The gate rechecks frozen science source and cache amendment hashes, but does not independently recheck PLAN_LOCK.method_receipts_sha256 or EVALUATION_PROTOCOL against the plan digest. The downstream evaluator does enforce plan-bound predictions and a canonical protocol before its reference decode; direct gate reporting claims more than its own checks.
findings.fix: Before writing GO verify frozen method-receipt digests, protocol digest and the prediction seal plan digest, or narrow gate wording and explicitly link the downstream pre-reference guard. Never rewrite the frozen hashes to current values.

findings.problem: An executable launch error (e.g. FileNotFoundError/PermissionError), or wrapper interruption, exits before any receipt is written. Thus the claim that failed actual attempts preserve wall/CPU/exit is incomplete.
findings.fix: Write a receipt in an exception/finally path with launch/termination status, wall/CPU/RSS, exception and unavailable exit_code=null. Preserve the original return/exception semantics and do not label a never-launched command as exit0.

findings.problem: The common.write helper rejects existing targets. Re-running cost/validation/bindings after rendering/publication updates cannot refresh those files unless a reviewed versioning/replacement path is used.
findings.fix: Plan one final generation, or preserve each prior receipt and explicitly version the updated final derivative. Do not silently discard original validation failures or timestamps.

pre_reference_assumptions: new_primary_reference_reads_before_gate=0 is an operational provenance assertion; this code alone cannot detect unrelated external processes reading reference files.
Original fixed references are hashed against their existing seal before decode; hashing the bytes is distinct from decoding ground-truth poses.
Runtime/cache source amendments must remain the approved pre-reference snapshots; current final source inventory is not a substitute for a frozen scientific source lock.
Budget conclusions are measured/conservative known subtotals, with explicitly unmeasured preparation and historical reuse scopes, not an exact campaign-wide CPU/GPU measurement.
